hero.lede: CDMCORP is a Sydney-based construction and project management consultancy. Independent representation for developers, owners, and principals across New South Wales — since 1984.

capability.heading: Sectors we work across
positioning: Independent — we act for the owner, not the builder.
NSW-based — Sydney office, projects across the state.
Fixed-scope engagements wherever the shape of the work allows.

steps.title: Brief
steps.detail: A short call, no charge. Tell us the project, the contract, and what you need.

steps.title: Scope and fee
steps.detail: A one-page scope with named deliverables, a fee, and a date. Signed both ways.

steps.title: Site and documents
steps.detail: Site walk where relevant. Documents review — programme, contract, RFIs, variations, correspondence.

steps.title: Report or engagement
steps.detail: A written report you can hand to a bank, a builder, or your board. Or an ongoing contract-admin, superintendent, or PM role.
